column2: Make resource deletion safer with name confirmation (#13104)
column7: Project deletion name confirmation; preserve Europa CSV modal/detail actions and invokedAsGroupAction. Typed-name guard also blocks keyboard submission and stale selected rows. Reset on close/new action; Korean prompt.

column2: Translation of missing labels to Portuguese (#12947)
column7: Apply 1232 source translation deltas without removing Europa-only or later S6 keys. Restore ABLESTACK in 13 translated values; preserve every baseline locale key.

column2: Fix select search icon orientation in dropdown menu (#13170)
column7: Exclude search suffix icon from open-select rotation; retain ordinary select arrow rotation.

column2: ui: do not show deploy instance button for not ready images (#13161)
column7: Show deploy only for ready templates or ready bootable ISOs; skip image lookup when unavailable. Mounted component regression covers readiness changes and zone loading.

column2: Custom login base domain using GUI whitelabel themes (#13412)
column7: API/VO/view loginbasedomain, independent S7 journal DDL and pre-S7 view. Preserve Europa JSON validator, static loginBaseDomain fallback and separate OAuth input; apply base domain to provider discovery and login. Actual API/DB and UI regression.

column2: UI: Don't set management server ID if cookie isn't set (#13404)
column7: SAML path commits SET_MS_ID only for a present cookie; real router guard tests cover undefined, empty and defined cookie.

column2: UI: Fix missing label.allocated key in Status widget test mock (#13546)
column7: Correct allocated-label status fixture and include existing Status tests in full UI regression.

column2: fix(ui): restore Account column hyperlink routing in list views (#13642)
column7: Account ID links, administrator name/domain fallback and quota-specific routing. Restore project account label outside quota; regular-user missing-ID remains plain text. Mounted slot regression.

Rule matchingPattern wildcard/case normalization retained; MinIO 8.6.0 plus OpenTelemetry 1.51.0/2.16.0 coexist; ApiServer imports and tracing retained. Last side source 8e933b735e21 is now applied and tested.

Host response retains guest OS, hypervisor/architecture and storage access groups. VolumeApiServiceImplTest retains CLVM lightweight migration and VMware power-state-lag tests with nonduplicated imports/braces. Last side source a951ac61d090 is now applied and tested.
